instruction: Set Chrome to display image thumbnails of 300x300 pixels in Google Image search results.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have settings to control the thumbnail size displayed in Google Image search results. Image thumbnail sizes are determined by Google's search interface, not by Chrome browser settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - Chrome browser settings cannot control Google Image search result thumbnail sizes
Thumbnail sizes are determined by Google's server-side search interface, not client-side browser settings

The metadata explanation accurately describes why this task is impossible
